This is table-stakes, not a discovery.
rules.how_to_apply: Before using ANY research output: confirm it reached Synthesize (web research = Verify(3-vote)+Synthesize ran; own analysis = each claim has path:line/query-result + tier). If not closed: say so directly, re-run, invent nothing. Label every presented item VERIFIED / INFERRED / NOT-ESTABLISHED. Do not launch web-dependent research while internet is flagged down. Phase A (close research) strictly precedes Phase B (conclusions/plans). Full spec: knowledge/research_closing_methodology.md.

rules.rule: Every domain is modeled as a PAIR — AS-DESIGNED (standard SAP) + AS-RUN (our process) — and scored across 9 capability dimensions (S_STANDARD_REF, A_PROCESS, B_CODE, C_CONFIG, D_DATA, E_AUTH, F_INTERFACE_FILE, G_CONFORMANCE=the delta, H_IMPROVE). This domain×capability matrix (Layer 15, brain_v2/capability_model/) IS the operating model. Work is SELECTED by querying `graph_queries.py capability_gaps` — the roadmap is generated, not written. Empty COLUMNS are systemic model gaps, not per-domain. The model is PORTABLE across projects (unesco-sap-brain etc.): standard AS-DESIGNED baselines are system-invariant and shared cross-project; AS-RUN deltas are project-specific and fed back to a shared library.
rules.why: s079: the process+code+conformance work is crucial to the MODEL, not a one-off plan. User: 'cómo lo reflejamos más allá del plan... los dominios deben ALINEARSE y luego AMPLIARSE'. A plan is consumed and archived; a model axis is queried and grows. Reflecting it structurally (4th axis) makes acquired knowledge align to one skeleton and makes every gap a deterministic, ranked work item.
rules.how_to_apply: At session start, read brain_state.capability_model. Before proposing work, run `graph_queries.py capability_gaps` and pick from the ranked expansion_order. When a domain is touched (incident/claim/companion), update its capability cell. A capability is fully met only when BOTH strata exist AND the G delta is computed. Never present an AS-RUN finding as conformance without the AS-DESIGNED baseline (S_STANDARD_REF precondition). Keep the matrix honest: ●HAVE/◐PARTIAL/○NONE per cell with evidence. Full spec: knowledge/capability_model.md.

rules.rule: Every CLOSED deep-research is archived under brain_v2/research/ (full result + sources + findings). Before launching ANY new deep-research, DEDUPE against brain_v2/research/sources_index.json (91 urls already read) and findings_registry.json (37 verified + 26 refuted). Do NOT re-fetch a source already analyzed or re-litigate a verified/refuted claim — READ the archive. Scope new runs to ENRICH the named openQuestions, not to repeat. Append, never overwrite. A FAILED/degraded run is logged in _run_log.json and superseded by a solo rerun — never re-run the same degraded query.
rules.why: s079: deep-research outputs lived in EPHEMERAL temp files — they would be lost, forcing re-reads/re-runs of already-analyzed sources (waste + CP-002 violation). User: 'guarda los deep researchs para enriquecerlos en el futuro y no tener que releer algo que ya analizaste'.
rules.how_to_apply: At research time: (1) grep sources_index.json for the candidate domains/urls; (2) if covered, cite the archived finding instead of re-fetching; (3) read the target research's openQuestions and scope the new run ONLY to those gaps; (4) after a run closes, archive it via the same persist pattern (full result + update sources_index + findings_registry). Run SERIALLY (concurrency degrades Verify).

rules.rule: Distinguish TECHNICAL decisions (the agent OWNS — do not ask) from STRATEGIC/BUSINESS-REALITY decisions that only the user/org can answer and that DETERMINE SCOPE/RELEVANCE (ASK before investing). Migration strategy (brownfield vs greenfield), which systems/company-codes/domains are in scope, business priorities, chosen vendors/paths — these are org facts NOT derivable from code/data/sensible defaults. Assuming one risks wasting a whole research/build. A focused question is cheaper than discarded work.
rules.why: s079: I assumed greenfield was in scope (it was in an openQuestion) and was about to run a full RES-S4-GREENFIELD research — but UNESCO uses BROWNFIELD. The research would have been wasted. User: 'como feedback sería buena la pregunta de qué estrategia usaríamos'. This complements (does NOT contradict) own_the_decision/no_menus: own the technical HOW; ask the strategic WHICH-PATH that the org decides.
rules.how_to_apply: Before scoping a research/build whose RELEVANCE depends on a strategic choice (migration approach, in-scope systems, chosen path/vendor, business priority), check: is this a fact I can derive from code/data/defaults, or an org decision? If org decision and it changes what work is relevant -> ask ONE focused question (AskUserQuestion) first. Still own the technical HOW (no menus for implementation). The test: 'would assuming this waste consequential work if wrong?' -> if yes, ask.

claims.claim: AVC available is a fund/cover-group level metric, not an FR-line-level metric. All FR lines on the same (FONDS, FUNDSCTR, CMMTITEM-rolled-to-control-object) draw from a single shared AVC pool. The pool is calculated as: Available = FMAVCT.allotment - sum(open FMIOI commitments) - sum(FMIFIIT actuals) on the same key. FMAVC005 fires when Available <= 0 + new posting amount > 0. The triggering FR line is incidental; the constraint is the fund pool.

claims.claim: YTBAE002 has an empty-RANGE-to-unbounded-LDB-scan defect at `YTBAE002.abap:1366-1370`. The LOOP AT LR_SAKNR that APPENDs each local SAKNR range entry to the COSEL/RSPARAMS table has NO `IS NOT INITIAL` guard. When the upstream SKB1 SELECT at `YTBAE002.abap:1098-1101` (WHERE BUKRS+HBKID+HKTID) returns zero rows that both (a) have SAKNR+3(2) IN ('11','13','15') AND (b) have XOPVW='X' (see IF chain at lines 1112-1118), the GR_SAKNR_OI range is empty, the loop iterates zero times, zero `SD_SAKNR` entries are pushed to LT_PARAMS, and `CALL FUNCTION 'LDB_PROCESS' LDBNAME='SDF'` at `YTBAE002.abap:1509-1517` runs BSIS with only `SD_BUKRS + SD_GJAHR + SD_STIDA + SD_CURTP` as filters. In SAP behavior an empty IN-list means no filter, so the LDB scans BSIS unrestricted by HKONT. At UNESCO that is 228,242 BSIS rows for BUKRS='UNES' GJAHR='2026' (live P01 RFC probe 2026-04-20), driving SAPDBSDF:1983 PUT_BSIS past the dialog `rdisp/max_wprun_time` cap and terminating with runtime error TIME_OUT. claims.claim: XSLT CGI_XML_CT_XSLT (SAP-std, devclass=ID-DMEE) is an identity transformation with EMPTY-ELEMENT REMOVAL. Template 2 matches '*[string() or @*[string()]]' — copies elements with text content or attributes with values. EFFECT: V001 structured PstlAdr nodes that are empty (e.g., <BldgNb/> when vendor has no HOUSE_NUM1) are AUTOMATICALLY REMOVED from final XML before file write. Major design simplification: V001 tree can emit ALL 5 structured nodes unconditionally — XSLT filters empty ones at runtime. Vendors with only CITY1+COUNTRY produce CBPR+-valid Hybrid-minimum output (TwnNm+Ctry) by default. Note: applies to CITI tree only (XSLTDESC field set in DMEE_TREE_HEAD). SEPA and CGI trees do NOT have XSLTDESC — for those trees we still need explicit DMEE_TREE_COND to suppress empty nodes.

claims.claim: MULESOFT vs FB01 path distinction (user clarification Session #69): MULESOFT integration moves BOR (Budget Original Reservation, budget-side only) - it does NOT move commitments or real postings. FB01 is a real-posting RECLASSIFICATION transaction in FI - it moves actual money between accounts/funds in the live ledger. They serve different purposes: (1) MULESOFT = automated budget loading at biennium-start, carries Workplan/Allocation context including FIPEX-aware Commitment_Item__c. (2) FB01 = manual real-posting reclassifications (mid-biennium adjustments, biennium-end revenue moves like A_BANSAL 257-doc batch). Implication for fix paths: FIX-A (MULESOFT FIPEX-aware) ONLY helps biennium-start budget loading. It has NO effect on FB01 reclassifications, which produce the actual model-gap defect at biennium-end. The 257 FB01s on 2026-01-31 are real postings - they bypass any MULESOFT enhancement. Therefore: FIX-A scope is narrow. FIX-E (pre-flight HARD-BLOCK on FB01/FMBB/FMBBT) is necessary. FIX-F (Meta-AVC) is the ONLY path that catches every change source (budget OR real, automated OR manual).

claims.claim: META-AVC architecture (user proposal Session #69, FIX-F): Replace the two independent AVC engines (FM-AVC at Fund/FundCenter/CommItem granularity + PS-AVC at WBS granularity) with a SINGLE meta-AVC engine that holds the combined availability state and validates BOTH granularities atomically at posting time. The meta-AVC blocks a posting if (1) FM pool < 0 OR (2) PS pool < 0 OR (3) FM-pool and PS-pool DIVERGE (which is exactly the INC-005638 signature). This subsumes FIX-A (works for any path manual or automated), FIX-E (works at every posting not just pre-flight), FIX-D (any cross-engine misalignment is caught immediately by divergence detection). Architecturally: enhancement BAdI on the AVC framework, or a unified AVC environment in S/4. Estimated effort 2-3 sprints. Strategic value: removes the structural dichotomy between FM and PS engines that produces 6,232 BAD-state pairs UNESCO-wide. This is the ONLY fix that closes the model gap permanently rather than mitigating it.

claims.claim: Root config that PERMITS the FM-PS model gap (TIER_1 from fmavct_2026): UNESCO's AVC derivation rule FMAFMAP013500109 (env 9HZ00001) collapses 8 of the 9 operational FIPEX (11, 13, 20, 30, 40, 50, 10\' and REVENUE) into a SINGLE control object called TC. Only PSC (FIPEX 80) keeps its own separate control object. Therefore the AVC engine validates against only 2 buckets per fund (TC + 80) instead of the 9 FIPEX visible in FMIFIIT. The TC bucket includes REVENUE in its pool, so as long as REVENUE > sum(operational consumption), TC stays positive and AVC permits postings — even though individual operational FIPEX are deeply negative. AVC is structurally blind to per-FIPEX deficits because it never sees them. Diagnosis: kernel-version limitation on EhP8 ADT, not a wrapper bug — POST to create the PROG and POST to lock both succeed; only the PUT to source/main with the otherwise-valid handle fails. data_quality.issue: Structural model gap: UNESCO runs two AVC engines (FM-AVC per (FUND, FUNDSCTR, CommItem); PS-AVC per WBS) at different granularities. They disagree at biennium close-out on TYPE 101-112 donor funds because revenue is loaded onto a placeholder FIPEX (REVENUE) that does not match the AVC-derivation range, while consumption posts to operational FIPEX (11, 13, 20, 30, ...). Result: FM-AVC blocks SES / MIRO / F110 postings while the PS-AVC project pool reports healthy. This is a configuration-level defect (FIPEX-derivation strategy + revenue-loading procedure), not a bug in custom code.

monitoring_blindness_2026_05_03.finding: UNESCO primary Project Manager dashboard (YPS8) and budget/expenditure report (YFM1) use the same IS_COMMITMENT_ITEM_IN_AVC filter as FM-AVC. Therefore the monitoring tool is as blind as the engine. Project Managers cannot pre-empt INC-005638-class incidents from YPS8 alone.
monitoring_blindness_2026_05_03.implication: Any monitoring/alerting strategy must use a per-FIPEX detector (e.g., committed_vs_available_detector.py) INSTEAD OF or IN ADDITION TO YPS8/YFM1, because YPS8/YFM1 will not surface the gap. This is independent of fixes G/H/I/F — even after fixing AVC config, the reports themselves should be reviewed.

data_quality.central_narrative_2026_05_02: AVC absence/misconfiguration is the UPSTREAM root cause. Everything downstream (FB01 batches, closure protocols, workplan reprogramming, MULESOFT mappings, PO redirects) are symptoms or transport layers. SAP knew about the open commitments but had no guardian to enforce the constraint. The structural fix priority is therefore: FIX-G1 (granular AVC per-FIPEX) + FIX-G2 (exclude REVENUE from TC pool) + FIX-G3 (enable AVC for non-Earmarked TYPEs that need it) + FIX-H (remove REVENUE preservation in YCL_YPS8_BCS_BL). FIX-F Meta-AVC is the long-term strategic enhancement that ALSO adds cross-engine FM<->PS consistency check at every posting. FIX-A MULESOFT is deprecated. FIX-D/E/B are mitigations of symptoms.

data_quality.title: v001_change_matrix.csv row 1 (SEPA Cdtr/StrtNm → FPAYP/REF01) contradicts code reading
data_quality.summary: Matrix row 1 binds /SEPA_CT_UNES Cdtr/StrtNm to FPAYP/REF01 with rationale 'CM005 line 109 writes Cdtr to FPAYP-REF01'. Direct code reading of CL_IDFI_CGI_CALL05_GENERIC->GENERIC_CALL line 108-115 shows the LOOP writes <fs_fpayp>-ref01+0(60) = ls_adrc-street where ls_adrc was loaded via get_company_address(zbukr) — i.e. PAYING-CO address, not vendor. Under this code path, the matrix-row-1 binding would render UNESCO HQ street as <Cdtr><StrtNm>. Empirical 2026-05-07 BERTOLDINI test rendered VENDOR street ('BFM/FAS/PAY') under V001, which is inconsistent with the matrix-row-1 design.
candidate_explanations: (A) The actual V001 binding deployed to D01 SEPA tree differs from matrix-row-1 — the deployed binding uses FPAYH-ZSTRA (vendor street Z-field) directly, and the matrix row 1 is forward-design only.
(B) FPAYP-REF01 layout for SEPA differs from FPAYHX-REF01 for CGI — but matrix row 1 says they're identical (CM005 line 109 cite).
(C) There's another code path that overwrites FPAYP-REF01 with vendor data after GENERIC_CALL (e.g. a BAdI or another Event).
verification_plan: (1) RFC-extract DMEE_TREE_NODE WHERE TREE_ID='/SEPA_CT_UNES' AND VERSION='001' for node N_3513093480 (per matrix row 1) — read MP_SC_TAB and MP_SC_FLD.

(2) If (1) returns MP_SC_TAB=FPAYP, MP_SC_FLD=REF01, then trace the V001 BERTOLDINI F110 run on 2026-05-07 — check whether SAPFPAYM_MERGE bypassed CGI_05 entirely (using ZSAPFPAYM_REPLAY path) which would explain a different REF01 population.
(3) Examine ZSAPFPAYM_REPLAY's FPAYHX/FPAYP construction — does it call FI_PAYMEDIUM_DMEE_CGI_05 or pre-populate REF01 from REGUH/FPAYH-ZSTRA?

incidents.title: Budget Rate custom solution allows cross-currency consumption against EUR-reserved FR -> AVC pool drift -> FMAVC005
incidents.reporter: Laetitia Vonthron (adm.cad) -> Christina Lopez-Chemouny -> Yimiao Guo -> Illya Konakov -> Pablo Lopez
incidents.primary_subject: FR 3250117351 line 39 (EUR carryforward to 2026, fund 3110111021 / FUNDSCTR PAX / CMMTITEM TC); EqG ticket reimbursement for SG Bivini Mangue
error_messages: FMAVC005 Annual budget exceeded by 0,87 USD (FM Availability Control) for document item 00002
incidents.root_cause_summary: 15-member ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE composite has gate-input asymmetry: Camp A (FR-anchored: CHECK_CONS, EF_FUND_RESERVATION, FUNDBLOCK) always fires for EUR FRs; Camp B (posting-anchored: PAYCOMMIT, NEW_ITEM, AVC, KBLEW, FI) silently skips when posting currency is not EUR. FR persisted at BR (1.09529); consumption persisted at identity. AVC pool drifts fund-by-fund until cover-group hits zero headroom. Vonthron's fund 3110111021/PAX/TC has $12,897.80 budget exactly matched by $12,897.80 of carryforward FR commitments -> Available=0 -> any new USD posting fires FMAVC005.
code_validation_chain: extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM00A line 8: APPEND 'EUR' to mr_waers (the perimeter line)
extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM004: check_conditions exits abap_false if iv_waers NOT IN mr_waers
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_CHECK_CONS Enh1 (Camp A): iv_waers = m_r_doc->m_f_kblk-waers (FR header EUR) -> PASS -> recalc -> Enh2 RESTORE original (in-memory only, no persistence)
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_NEW_ITEM (Camp B): iv_waers = c_f_fmoi-twaer (USD for USD posting) -> FAIL -> no recalc
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_AVC Enh1+3 (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmioi>-twaer / <ls_fmifiit>-twaer per-row -> mixed, USD rows skip
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_KBLEW (Camp B): iv_waers = ls_tr_kblew-waers (USD) -> FAIL -> no recalc

incidents.root_cause_summary: CONFIRMED via TIER_1 RFC pull (P01, 2026-05-01). FM-AVC engine fires (NOT PS-AVC). The AVC derivation rule FMAFMAP013500109 collapses FIPEX 10'..50 into a single AVC control object TC for fund 196EAR4042. UNESCO loads donor revenue (WRTTP=66) entirely on FIPEX=REVENUE placeholder, which falls OUTSIDE the TC derivation range. Result: TC bucket sees /usr/bin/bash revenue while ,561,651.78 of KBFC consumption lands there → pool depth -,561,651.78 → FMAVC005 "Annual budget exceeded" raised for every new SES on FIPEX 11/20 (the three incident POs all hit the TC bucket). Fund-level pool is +1.83M and PS-AVC project pool is +6.43M — both healthy — but the FM-AVC enforces at the AVC-derived bucket level, not fund level. The class is REVENUE-PLACEHOLDER vs AVC-DERIVATION-BUCKET misalignment, structural to UNESCO config, present on 1,330+457 = 1,787 buckets across UNESCO (Tier 1+2 of the misalignment classifier).

The Banco de Chile sub was retired (old 1109574 closed -> new 1110574 created) but OB09 was never repointed; the active main still points its LKORR adjustment to the closed sub. Two conditions needed for the runtime error: (1) OB09 points to a blocked sub AND (2) the main carries an FX balance to revalue.

capability_model._design: Layer 15 — Capability Model. The 4th axis of the domain taxonomy (after functional/module/process). Reflects the process+code+conformance work structurally: a domain is 'understood' only when 10 capability dimensions are covered for it (S precondition + A-H understanding + R composite readiness). ALIGN (re-express every domain on one skeleton) then EXPAND (every weak cell is the ranked roadmap). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the matrix — do not hand-copy the matrix into prose docs (it drifts). Born Session #079.

_strata.note: A domain is a PAIR, not one model. The product lives in the delta. Capability G = compare AS_RUN against AS_DESIGNED. Conformance has TWO preconditions per domain: the standard baseline AND our process. Capturing AS_DESIGNED per domain is itself a precondition capability (S_STANDARD_REF below), mostly NONE today.
_strata.AS_DESIGNED: how SAP designed the domain — normative reference flow/objects/config as delivered (SAP Best Practices / PaPM reference content)
_strata.AS_RUN: how UNESCO actually does it — real process from data + Z-code/config/exits/.NET apps/workflows on top
_strata.DELTA: G_CONFORMANCE — where AS_RUN extends/deviates from AS_DESIGNED, down to the implementing object (the custom-over-standard x-ray)

_portability.note: This capability model is NOT project-specific — it is the OPERATING MODEL / way of working. It applies to other projects (e.g. unesco-sap-brain) verbatim: same 10 dimensions + AS-DESIGNED/AS-RUN strata. Cross-project feedback: a standard SAP AS-DESIGNED baseline captured once is reusable across ALL projects (standard is system-invariant); each project contributes its AS-RUN deltas back to a shared library. Governed by the ecosystem-coordinator.
